transcript.text: I wanna know what was the worst part about last week? Wasn't the embarrassment? Wasn't the fact that I got escorted out of the arena on ITV? Hell, it wasn't even Deion thinking that he got one up on me. It was what I felt. It was that damn claw that I had to make. Because while security had me pinned down for a split second, I wasn't the Cruz Montana that you see today. I wasn't the man who has

sacrificed everything just to be able to look at the man in the mirror and be proud of him. I was the other guy. I was the man who I've spent years trying to keep buried away. Deion, it was your hands that brought that out of me. And when I get my hands on you, there ain't nobody that's gonna be able to pull me away. The worst thing you could have done, Deion, was bring my family into this. Oka Oda, my past, it comes your future.
